text:
len: quick design sync  pushed an updated routing policies editor mock. main changes: collapsible help sidebar, denser rule chips, and a preview overlay state when validation errors exist. need quick checks on contrast, focus clipping under the header, and the disabled-preview wording. figma: https://figma.mock/route-editor

dave: :eyes: looks cleaner. accessibility stuff first: focus ring on rule items gets hidden under the sticky header when tabbing  can we auto-scroll focused item into view or make the header collapse on keyboard focus?

emma: contrast check on chips: bg #F3F6FA + text #111827 = 3.9:1 at 14px. fails. options: darken text to #0A0F18 (4.7:1) or change bg to #E9EEF4. i'd favor darkening text to preserve tokens and density.

jules: copy nit for disabled preview banner: current "Fix rules to preview" is terse. prefer "Resolve rule issues to enable preview"  clearer, screen-reader friendly. also avoid imperatives like "fix" on inactive controls.

a11y-bot: checklist: add aria-live="polite" for validation updates, set aria-hidden on preview region when overlay active, provide visible focus ring (2px) and ensure focused item scrolls under header.

len: decision summary: chip text -> #0A0F18 at 14px; implement .rule-item:focus { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: 2px; } auto-scroll focused rule into view under header; help sidebar collapses to compact bar on keyboard focus and scroll; disable preview toggle when there are invalid rules and show inline banner with jules' copy. jules/dave  can you open a PR with CSS token changes, aria attributes, and screenshots for visual regression? include i18n key: preview.disabled.resolve_rules = "Resolve rule issues to enable preview".

dave: will open branch dave/ux/rules-focus-clip and include e2e that verifies focus scrolling + aria-live text appears.

emma: i'll update design tokens and add a short note in the component docs about header collapse behaviour and preview-disabled rationale.

a11y-bot: queued automated checks for branch dave/ux/rules-focus-clip  will post results here.

len: thanks team! small win for a11y and density :thumbsup:
